newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDISH PLANE TURNS BACK TO DUMP SCOTTISH FANS.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH PLANE TURNS BACK TO DUMP SCOTTISH FANS.

text.p: A chartered plane full of Scottish soccer supporters returned to Sweden early on Thursday to take off five drunken and troublesome fans, police said.
The fans had been at Scotland's World Cup qualifying match against Sweden on Wednesday evening in the western city of Gothenburg. Scotland lost 2-1.
The plane took off from Gothenburg but returned soon afterwards because the pilot could not guarantee a safe flight.
It was not immediately known whether the fans would face any charges.
